description: This file defines the FrameMapper class responsible for mapping and propagating frame timing information across different trace types in an Android performance analysis tool.

classes.name: FrameMapper
classes.description: A class that manages the mapping and propagation of frame timing information across various trace types such as screen recording, surface flinger, transactions, window manager, proto log, and input methods.

methods.name: computeMapping
methods.description: Initiates the process of selecting the most reliable trace and propagating frame info.

methods.name: pickMostReliableTraceAndSetInitialFrameInfo
methods.description: Selects the preferred trace type and sets initial frame info based on it.

methods.name: propagateFrameInfoToOtherTraces
methods.description: Propagates frame info across different trace types in a sequence.

methods.name: tryPropagateFromScreenRecordingToSurfaceFlinger
methods.description: Maps frames from screen recording trace to surface flinger trace based on timestamp proximity.

methods.name: tryPropagateFromSurfaceFlingerToTransactions
methods.description: Maps frames from surface flinger to transactions trace using vSync IDs.

methods.name: tryPropagateFromTransactionsToWindowManager
methods.description: Maps frames from transactions to window manager trace based on timestamp slices.

methods.name: tryPropagateFromWindowManagerToProtoLog
methods.description: Maps frames from window manager to proto log trace based on sequential entries.

methods.name: tryPropagateFromWindowManagerToIme
methods.description: Maps frames from window manager to input method traces with time proximity constraints.

methods.name: propagateFromWindowManagerToIme
methods.description: Performs the actual frame mapping from window manager to IME traces.

methods.name: tryStartFrameMapping
methods.description: Initializes a FrameMapBuilder for mapping between two trace types if frame info is available.

methods.name: getVsyncIdProperty
methods.description: Extracts and converts a vSync ID property from a trace entry to a bigint.
